description: Called when a block fades, melts or disappears based on world conditions Examples: Snow melting due to being near a light source. Ice melting due to being near a light source. Fire burning out after time, without destroying fuel block. Coral fading to dead coral due to lack of water Turtle Egg bursting when a turtle hatches If a Block Fade event is cancelled, the block will not fade, melt or disappear.
